app.social.alerts.commented.note: A row of the Alerts tab (the list of notifications): a friend commented on one of your posts. {name} is the friend's profile name (or their device's address when they have none), shown in bold (…). A tap opens the post.

app.social.alerts.empty.note: Shown in the middle of the Alerts tab (the list of notifications: friends' likes, comments and requests, and the device's own alerts) while it has none.

app.social.alerts.error_more.note: First line of a row of the Alerts tab that groups several errors of the device. {title} is the first error's title, written by the device (already in the user's language), shown in bold (…); {count} is how many more errors the group holds, shown in grey (…). A tap shows every error's line.

app.social.alerts.friend_accepted.note: A row of the Alerts tab (the list of notifications): someone accepted the friend request you sent. {name} is their profile name (or their device's address when they have none), shown in bold (…).

app.social.alerts.friend_request.note: A row of the Alerts tab (the list of notifications): someone sent you a friend request; an Accept button may follow on the row. {name} is their profile name (or their device's address when they have none), shown in bold (…).

app.social.alerts.liked_comment.note: A row of the Alerts tab (the list of notifications): a friend liked one of your comments. {name} is the friend's profile name (or their device's address when they have none), shown in bold (…). A tap opens the post.

app.social.alerts.liked_post.note: A row of the Alerts tab (the list of notifications): a friend liked one of your posts. {name} is the friend's profile name (or their device's address when they have none), shown in bold (…). A tap opens the post.

app.social.alerts.title.note: Title in the top bar of the Alerts tab, the list of notifications (friends' likes, comments and requests, and the device's own alerts).

app.social.compose.camera.note: Screen-reader name of the camera button at the left of the caption box in the New Post composer: takes a photo or records a video to add to the post.

app.social.compose.caption_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the caption box at the foot of the New Post composer (the text that goes with the post's photos). A post needs one.

app.social.compose.empty_response.note: Why a synced video couldn't be opened for trimming in the New Post composer: the device sent back an empty file. Shown as the detail of app.social.compose.trim_load_failed.

app.social.compose.filter_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the search box over the Synced photos in the New Post composer: typing a tag (a word the device found in photos, such as beach) narrows the photos to those with it.

app.social.compose.order.note: Small heading of the strip of the photos picked for a new post, in the New Post composer: the order they will appear in the post (arrows under each move it).

app.social.compose.photos_access.text: Photos access is needed to pick from your phone.
app.social.compose.photos_access.note: Alert in the New Post composer when the app isn't allowed to read the phone's photos, so the Phone source (the phone's own photos) can't show them.

app.social.compose.publish.note: Button at the right of the caption box in the New Post composer, while no photo is picked yet (it is disabled then): publishes the post to your friends.

app.social.compose.publish_count.note: Button at the right of the caption box in the New Post composer: publishes the post to your friends. {number} is how many photos and videos are picked for it.

app.social.compose.publish_failed.note: Alert in the New Post composer when the device didn't accept the new post and gave no reason.

app.social.compose.publish_failed_detail.note: Alert in the New Post composer when the post couldn't be published. {detail} says why: the device's own words (already in the user's language), or the phone's reason (for example why a photo couldn't be uploaded).

app.social.compose.publishing.note: In the New Post composer while the post is being made: the Publish button's label, and the status line above the caption box once the photos from the phone are uploaded.

app.social.compose.source_phone.note: First half of the switch at the top of the New Post composer: shows this phone's own photos and videos (uploaded to the device when the post is published).

app.social.compose.source_synced.note: Second half of the switch at the top of the New Post composer: shows the photos and videos already on the device, searchable by tag.

app.social.compose.title.note: Title of the composer that makes a new post for your friends (pick photos or videos, write a caption, Publish).

app.social.compose.trim_badge.note: Small pill on a picked video in the New Post composer's strip of picked photos (60 points wide): tapping the video opens the trimmer, to post only part of it. Once trimmed the pill shows the length kept instead. Keep the scissors.

app.social.compose.trim_load_failed.text: Could not load that video to trim it: {detail}
app.social.compose.trim_load_failed.note: Alert in the New Post composer when a picked video couldn't be opened for trimming. {detail} says why (the phone's reason, or app.social.compose.empty_response).

app.social.compose.uploading.note: Status line above the caption box in the New Post composer while the photos picked from the phone are uploaded to the device before the post is made: {done} is the one being uploaded (1, 2…), {total} how many there are.

app.social.feed.empty_text.text: Share a photo or a video with your friends - it goes from your device to theirs, with no cloud in between.
app.social.feed.empty_text.note: Under the heading No social posts, on the Social feed when there are no posts yet; a big plus button under it opens the composer. The point: posts travel from your own device straight to your friends' devices.

app.social.feed.empty_title.note: Big heading of the Social feed (posts shared with friends) when there are no posts yet.

app.social.friends.add_heading.note: Heading of the section of the Friends screen where you type a friend's device name and send them a friend request.

app.social.friends.ask_theirs.text: Ask {name}'s device to delete what I shared
app.social.friends.ask_theirs.note: Switch (off at first) when removing a friend: also asks the friend's device to delete your posts, comments and likes there. {name} is the friend's profile name (or their device's address when they have none). Explained by app.social.friends.ask_theirs_text.

app.social.friends.ask_theirs_text.text: Your posts, comments and likes on their device. If it's offline, it happens the next time it connects; until then they show as leaving.
app.social.friends.ask_theirs_text.note: Explains the switch app.social.friends.ask_theirs when removing a friend: what their device is asked to delete, and that a friend whose device is offline is listed as Leaving (app.social.friends.status_leaving) until it has.

app.social.friends.block.note: Button on a friend's row in the Friends screen (for a request you received, or a friend): blocks them.

app.social.friends.cancel_confirm_text.text: The request will be withdrawn on both devices.
app.social.friends.cancel_confirm_text.note: Message of the confirmation app.social.friends.cancel_confirm_title, before withdrawing a friend request you sent: it is removed from your device and from theirs.

app.social.friends.cancel_confirm_title.note: Title of the confirmation asked before withdrawing a friend request you sent. Buttons: app.social.friends.cancel_request (in red) and Cancel (which keeps the request).

app.social.friends.cancel_request.note: Button (in red) of the confirmation app.social.friends.cancel_confirm_title: withdraws the friend request you sent, on both devices.

app.social.friends.cancel_request_button.note: Button (in red) on the row of a friend request you sent, in the Friends screen: asks to withdraw it (app.social.friends.cancel_confirm_title follows).

app.social.friends.delete_confirm_text.text: The request will be removed here and on the sender's device.
app.social.friends.delete_confirm_text.note: Message of the confirmation app.social.friends.delete_confirm_title, before declining a friend request you received: it is removed from your device and from the device of the person who sent it.

app.social.friends.delete_confirm_title.note: Title of the confirmation asked before declining a friend request you received (from the Decline button on its row). Buttons: app.social.friends.delete_request (in red) and Cancel (which keeps the request).

app.social.friends.delete_error.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when a friend request couldn't be withdrawn or declined because the device didn't answer.

app.social.friends.delete_failed.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when the device didn't withdraw or decline a friend request and gave no reason.

app.social.friends.delete_request.note: Button (in red) of the confirmation app.social.friends.delete_confirm_title: declines the friend request you received, removing it on both devices.

app.social.friends.delete_theirs_text.text: Their posts and photos, and their comments and likes on any post.
app.social.friends.delete_theirs_text.note: Explains the switch Delete everything from (a friend) on this phone, when removing a friend: what of theirs is deleted from your device.

app.social.friends.empty.note: Under the Friends heading of the Friends screen when you have no friends and no friend requests.

app.social.friends.friends_again.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen after sending a friend request to someone who already had you as a friend (for example after they set up their device again): you are friends at once.

app.social.friends.leaving_note.text: Waiting for their device to delete what you shared.
app.social.friends.leaving_note.note: Under the status of a friend being removed (Leaving), in the Friends screen: you asked their device to delete your posts, comments and likes, and it hasn't confirmed yet (it may be offline).

app.social.friends.list_heading.note: Heading of the section of the Friends screen that lists your friends and the requests you sent; a Refresh button is at its right.

app.social.friends.load_failed.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when the list of friends couldn't be read from the device.

app.social.friends.name_invalid.text: Enter the device's name, like pit - letters, digits and dashes.
app.social.friends.name_invalid.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when what was typed isn't a device name. A friend is added by their device's name (the part before .off-the.cloud); pit is an example of one: keep it as it is.

app.social.friends.name_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the box where you type a friend's device name to add them, in the Friends screen; the fixed .off-the.cloud follows the box. Lowercase in English, like the name it stands for.

app.social.friends.no_domain.note: In a friend's row of the Friends screen, in place of their device's address when it is missing.

app.social.friends.no_name.note: In a row of the Friends screen, in place of the person's profile name when they haven't set one.

app.social.friends.remove_button.note: Spoken label (and long-press hint) of the red trash button on a friend's row in the Friends screen: opens the choices for removing the friend (app.social.friends.remove_title).

app.social.friends.remove_error.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when a friend couldn't be removed because the device didn't answer.

app.social.friends.remove_failed.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when the device didn't remove a friend and gave no reason.

app.social.friends.remove_now.note: Button (in red) on the row of a friend being removed (Leaving) in the Friends screen, and on iPhone also the button of its confirmation (app.social.friends.remove_now_title): stops waiting for their device to delete what you shared and ends the friendship at once.

app.social.friends.remove_now_text.text: Stops waiting for their device. Whatever it hasn't deleted yet stays there.
app.social.friends.remove_now_text.note: Message of the confirmation app.social.friends.remove_now_title: your posts, comments and likes that the friend's device hasn't deleted yet stay on it.

app.social.friends.remove_now_title.note: Title of the confirmation asked before ending the friendship with a friend being removed (Leaving) without waiting for their device. {name} is the friend's profile name (or their device's address when they have none).

app.social.friends.remove_title.note: Title of the screen (or dialog) for removing a friend, with two switches (what to delete on each side) and the button to remove them. {name} is the friend's profile name (or their device's address when they have none).

app.social.friends.removed.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen once a friend has been removed.

app.social.friends.request_cancelled.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen once a friend request you sent has been withdrawn.

app.social.friends.request_deleted.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen once a friend request you received has been declined.

app.social.friends.request_failed.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when a friend request wasn't sent and the device gave no reason (when it gives one, its own words show instead).

app.social.friends.request_sent.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen once a friend request has been sent.

app.social.friends.send_error.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when a friend request couldn't be sent because the device didn't answer.

app.social.friends.status_accepted.note: Status under a friend's address in the Friends screen: the friendship is accepted.

app.social.friends.status_accepted_sent.note: Status under a friend's address in the Friends screen: the friend request you sent was accepted.

app.social.friends.status_blocked.note: Status under a person's address in the Friends screen: you blocked them.

app.social.friends.status_blocked_sent.note: Status under a person's address in the Friends screen: the friend request you sent was blocked.

app.social.friends.status_leaving.note: Status under a friend's address in the Friends screen: you removed them and asked their device to delete what you shared, and it hasn't confirmed yet.

app.social.friends.status_pending.note: Status under a person's address in the Friends screen: the friendship is waiting for your answer.

app.social.friends.status_pending_sent.note: Status under a person's address in the Friends screen: the friend request you sent is waiting for their answer.

app.social.friends.status_updated.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen once a friendship was accepted, blocked or set back to pending.

app.social.friends.title.note: Title of the Friends screen (a sheet opened from the Social feed, closed with Done): add friends and answer or manage friend requests.

app.social.friends.unexpected_response.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when the device answered a friend request or a status change with something the app doesn't understand.

app.social.friends.update_error.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when a friendship couldn't be accepted, blocked or set back to pending because the device didn't answer.

app.social.friends.update_failed.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen when the device didn't change a friendship's status and gave no reason (when it gives one, its own words show instead).

app.social.friends.waiting_answer.note: Heading of the section at the top of the Friends screen with the friend requests you received and haven't answered (Decline and Accept on each).

app.social.friends.waiting_their_device.note: Short message at the top of the Friends screen after removing a friend whose device was offline: it will be asked to delete what you shared the next time it connects.

app.social.likes.empty.note: In the list of who liked a post or a comment (opened from its like count), when it holds nobody.

app.social.likes.title.note: Title of the list of who liked a post or a comment, opened by tapping its number of likes in the Social feed.

app.social.post.comment.note: A comment under a post in the Social feed: {name} is who wrote it (their profile name), in bold (…), {comment} the comment itself.

app.social.post.comment_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the box under each post in the Social feed where you write a comment (sent with app.social.post.send_comment).

app.social.post.comment_unnamed.note: A comment under a post in the Social feed whose writer has no profile name: User (as app.social.post.unnamed) in bold (…), then {comment}, the comment itself.

app.social.post.delete_comment.note: Button (in red) of the confirmation app.social.post.delete_comment_title: deletes the comment.

app.social.post.delete_comment_title.note: Title of the confirmation asked before deleting a comment (from the bin beside it, on your own post or on a comment you wrote). Buttons: app.social.post.delete_comment and Cancel.

app.social.post.delete_post.note: Item (in red) of the menu of your own post in the Social feed, which asks app.social.post.delete_post_title, and the button (in red) of that confirmation, which deletes the post.

app.social.post.delete_post_title.note: Title of the confirmation asked before deleting one of your own posts. Buttons: app.social.post.delete_post and Cancel.

app.social.post.likes.note: Under a post's heart in the Social feed: how many people liked it. A tap lists who.

app.social.post.send_comment.note: Button at the right of the comment box under a post in the Social feed: sends the comment (a verb).

app.social.post.unnamed.note: In a post's header in the Social feed, in place of the name of whoever posted it when they have no profile name.

app.social.trim.cant_open.text: This video could not be opened.
app.social.trim.cant_open.note: In the Trim video screen of the New Post composer: why the video can't be trimmed (the phone couldn't open it).

app.social.trim.keeping.note: Under the two-handle slider of the Trim video screen (New Post composer): {kept} is the length of the part of the video that goes into the post, {total} the whole video's length, both as minutes:seconds.tenths (0:12.5).

app.social.trim.no_length.text: This video's length could not be read.
app.social.trim.no_length.note: In the Trim video screen of the New Post composer: why the video can't be trimmed (the phone couldn't tell how long it is).

app.social.trim.reading.note: Beside a spinner in the Trim video screen of the New Post composer, while the video is being opened.

app.social.trim.remove.note: Button of the Trim video screen (New Post composer), shown when the video was trimmed before: posts the whole video again.

app.social.trim.title.note: Title of the screen of the New Post composer where you choose the part of a video that goes into the post (Cancel and Apply in its bar).
